what: R14: localization in the deployed configuration (coverage) per edited trial of E7 and E8: quarantine size in seconds and rows, the untouched suspect seconds attributed to each edit (keylog-range spillover), whether the quarantine covers every tampered element, Figure 6's per-trial over-quarantine, and summaries per arm and monitor with exact intervals
answers: R3 W4: 'report Figure 6's metrics and the suspect seconds per edit for E7 and E8, from existing files'
R1 W4: 'Report the E8 quarantine sizes'

definitions.quarantine_Q: the verifier's flagged one-second segments in the window (exp/stages/e7_verify.py flagged_seconds; window rule t_start - 1 <= s <= t_end + 1)
definitions.covered: every tampered element's second (edited row: clean second; deleted event: its second; inserted row: the second it was backdated or moved into) lies in Q
definitions.keys_flagged_by_verifier: every tampered element's key is an attributable row, a keylog suspect or a row removed from a failed key range
definitions.Q_i: Q intersected with the trial's element seconds, the seconds of every failed keylog range holding one of its keys, and localized seconds of attributable minute/hour violations containing an element second
definitions.spill_i: Q_i minus every second touched by any trial of the window (paper's counting rule + deleted events): untouched suspect seconds attributed to this edit
definitions.over_quarantine: |rows of Q_i minus every tampered key of the window| / |surviving rows of the window| (Figure 6's per-trial OQ, exp/sp2027/r2_localize.py)
definitions.not_computed: the component policy of Figure 6 (needs the stage24 recomputation over the recorder graph, which no saved file holds)
definitions.shared_quarantine: consecutive trials share failed key ranges, so Q_i of neighbouring trials overlap; per-trial sums double count, the window's union is quarantine_window

windows.window_rule: second s with t_start - 1 <= s <= t_end + 1

quarantine_window.published_figure_is: e7_verify's whole-chain list (E7 was not re-scored per window); it equals the whole-chain recomputation
